units.source_text: 是日秋好皇后开始举行春季讲经。

en.t: On that day, Empress Akikonomu began the spring lecture on the scriptures.

units.source_text: 有许多女眷昨夜不曾回家，就在六条院歇息。

en.t: Many of the ladies had not gone home the night before, but had rested at the Rokujo estate.

units.source_text: 今天大家换上昼用服装，准备前往听经。

en.t: Today they all changed into daytime clothing and prepared to go hear the scripture lecture.

units.source_text: 其他家中有事之人，都回去了。

en.t: The others who had matters to attend to at home had all gone back.

units.source_text: 正午时分，大家聚集在秋殿。

en.t: Around noon, everyone gathered at the Autumn Hall.

units.source_text: 自源氏以下，无不参与其会。

en.t: From Genji on down, no one failed to take part in the gathering.

units.source_text: 殿上人等也全体出席。

en.t: The courtiers of the palace also attended in full.

units.source_text: 这多半是源氏的威势所使然。

en.t: This was largely due to Genji's power and prestige.

units.source_text: 因此这法会隆重庄严无比。

en.t: As a result, the Buddhist service was extraordinarily grand and solemn.

units.source_text: 春殿的紫夫人发心向佛献花。

en.t: Lady Murasaki of the Spring Hall was moved to offer flowers to the Buddha.

units.source_text: 她选择八个相貌端正的女童，分为两班，四个扮作鸟，四个扮作蝶。

en.t: She chose eight pretty young girls, divided them into two groups, and dressed four as birds and four as butterflies.

units.source_text: 令鸟装的女童手持银瓶，内插樱花；蝶装的女童手持金瓶，内插棣棠花。

en.t: She had the girls dressed as birds carry silver vases filled with cherry blossoms, while the girls dressed as butterflies carried gold vases filled with kerria flowers.

units.source_text: 同是樱花与棣棠花，但她所选的是最美的花枝。

en.t: They were the same cherry blossoms and kerria flowers as any others, but the branches she had chosen were the most beautiful.

units.source_text: 八个女童乘了船，从殿前的小山脚上出发，向皇后的秋殿前进。

en.t: The eight girls boarded a boat and set out from the foot of the small hill before the hall, moving toward the Empress's Autumn Hall.

units.source_text: 春风拂拂，瓶中的樱花飞落数片。

en.t: A gentle spring breeze stirred, and several cherry petals fluttered down from the vases.

units.source_text: 天色晴明，日丽风和。

en.t: The sky was clear, the sun was bright, and the wind was mild.

units.source_text: 女童的船从春云叆叇之间款款而来，这情景美丽可爱！

en.t: The girls' boat came slowly through the drifting spring clouds, a scene of lovely beauty.

units.source_text: 秋殿的院内没有特地搭起帐篷来，就在殿旁的廊房里设置临时凳椅，作为乐池。

en.t: In the courtyard of the Autumn Hall, no special tent had been set up; instead, temporary benches and seats were arranged in the corridor beside the hall to serve as the musicians' area.

units.source_text: 八个女童舍舟登陆，从正面石阶上拾级升殿，奉献鲜花。

en.t: The eight girls left the boat and came ashore, climbed the front stone steps one by one, entered the hall, and offered the fresh flowers.

units.source_text: 香火师便接了花瓶，供在净水旁边。

en.t: The incense attendant then received the vases and placed them as offerings beside the pure water.

units.source_text: 紫夫人致秋好皇后的信，由夕雾中将呈上。

en.t: Lady Murasaki's letter to Empress Akikonomu was presented by Lieutenant General Yugiri.

en.t: In it, a poem read as follows:
